name: phpstats/juphyter
description: A Jupyter and Quarto kernel for PHP, built for statistical work with the phpstats packages

suggest.phpstats/phibble: Data frames rendered as notebook tables. Not on Packagist: add the VCS repository https://github.com/phpstats/phibble, then composer require --dev phpstats/phibble
suggest.phpstats/phplyr: A dplyr-style grammar over phibble frames, used by the examples. Not on Packagist: add the VCS repository https://github.com/phpstats/phplyr, then composer require --dev phpstats/phplyr
suggest.phpstats/phiz: Plots rendered as notebook figures. Installing it needs PHP 8.5, so a dev install below 8.5 has to leave it out. Not on Packagist: add the VCS repository https://github.com/phpstats/phiz, then composer require --dev phpstats/phiz
suggest.ext-pcntl: Interrupting a running cell, through SIGINT
suggest.ext-posix: Reaping the engine process the transport spawns
suggest.ext-sockets: The unix domain socket between the transport and the engine
